build_conversation_game_master: build a conversation game master entity using the GameMaster prefab with a language model and memory bank
configure_acting_order: configure the acting order for conversation turns using fixed, random, or game_master_choice mode
set_termination_control: set whether the conversation game master can terminate the simulation via the can_terminate_simulation parameter
create_next_game_master_transition: create a next game master transition that decides when the conversation is finished and passes control
review_event_resolution: review the event resolution component that resolves conversation events and sends observations to players
